result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection on a one-way street featuring a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and wide, well-maintained sidewalks. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and traffic lights are present, there is a lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals or physical traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, which can lead to confusion regarding the safe crossing interval.

hazards.name: Wide One-Way Roadway
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane one-way configuration can encourage higher vehicle speeds and increases the exposure time for pedestrians crossing the street.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals

interventions.description: Program the signals to give pedestrians a head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light, reducing conflicts with turning vehicles.
